name: Compute Cluster S76: Time Series Models
description: Tests: rolling_arima, rolling_garch(distribution=normal/studentt), kalman_filter(model_type=random_walk/local_linear_trend/constant_velocity), hmm, johansen, multi_linear_fit. Statistical time series models.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S76: Time Series Models
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

ret = returns(close)

ref = reference_stocks(ticker="QQQ")()
ref_close = ref.c
ref_ret = returns(ref_close)

# === ROLLING ARIMA ===
arima = rolling_arima()(close)

# === ROLLING GARCH: normal + student-t ===
garch_n = rolling_garch(distribution=DistributionType.normal, window_size=252, step_size=21)(ret)
garch_t = rolling_garch(distribution=DistributionType.studentt, window_size=252, step_size=21)(ret)
garch_n_vol = garch_n.volatility
garch_t_vol = garch_t.volatility

# === KALMAN FILTER: 3 model types ===
kf_rw = kalman_filter(model_type=KalmanModelType.random_walk)(close)
kf_llt = kalman_filter(model_type=KalmanModelType.local_linear_trend)(close)
kf_cv = kalman_filter(model_type=KalmanModelType.constant_velocity)(close)
kf_rw_state = kf_rw.filtered_level
kf_llt_state = kf_llt.filtered_level
kf_cv_state = kf_cv.filtered_level

# === HMM (needs tuple input) ===
hmm_val = hmm()((ret,))
hmm_state = hmm_val.state

# === JOHANSEN (tuple input) ===
joh = johansen(window=252, num_vars=2)((close, ref_close))
joh_spread = joh.spread

# === MULTI LINEAR FIT (y + tuple of x_vars, needs 2+ factors) ===
ref2 = reference_stocks(ticker="IWM")()
ref2_ret = returns(ref2.c)
mlf = multi_linear_fit(num_vars=2, window=60)(ret, (ref_ret, ref2_ret))
mlf_rsq = mlf.r_squared

# === ROLLING CORRELATION: kendall + spearman ===
corr_k = corr(ret, ref_ret, window=60, method=CorrelationMethod.kendall)
corr_s = corr(ret, ref_ret, window=60, method=CorrelationMethod.spearman)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='GARCH Volatility: Normal vs Student-t',
    category='GARCH',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Normal', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Student-t', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(garch_n_vol, garch_t_vol))

xy_lines(
    title='Kalman Filter: RW vs LLT vs CV',
    category='Kalman',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Close', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='KF Random Walk', color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='KF Local Linear', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='KF Const Velocity', color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(close, kf_rw_state, kf_llt_state, kf_cv_state))

xy_lines(
    title='HMM Regime State',
    category='Regime',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='HMM State', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=hmm_state)

xy_lines(
    title='Rolling Corr: Kendall vs Spearman',
    category='Correlation',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Kendall', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Spearman', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(corr_k, corr_s))
